mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 650K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8% and increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 150K signals a strengthening labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 8% and PAYEMS > 150K, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production index (INDPRO) below 90 signals decreased supply chain pressures, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO < 90, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real disposable income (RSAFS) above $390B signals increased consumer spending power, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high RSAFS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.5% and decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below 220 signals a monetary policy-driven decrease in inflation expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL < 220, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 130K signals a strengthening labor market, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of late-cycle instances when PAYEMS > 130K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) below $13.2T signals decreased aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during early-cycle contractions.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of early-cycle contraction instances when GDPC1 < $13.2T, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
